 Dozens of new cars in storage area stuck in flash floods (video)
 Based on images on social media, murky water could be seen covering almost the entire area, with water levels reaching as high as the doors of some vehicles.
 Updated 1 hour ago · Published on 02 Nov 2026 5:58PM
 The post drew the attention of social media users, many of whom were shocked to see the state of the new cars. - November 2, 2026 
 DOZENS of new cars were left ‘submerged’ after a vehicle storage area in Subang was hit by flooding following heavy rain this afternoon.
 The incident went viral on social media through several photographs showing rows of new vehicles sitting in floodwaters.
 Based on images on social media, murky water could be seen covering almost the entire area, with water levels reaching as high as the doors of some vehicles.
 The post drew the attention of social media users, many of whom were shocked to see the state of the new cars.
 As of now, the exact number of affected vehicles and the extent of the damage caused by the incident remain unknown.
 Heavy rain this afternoon also triggered flash floods in several locations around Subang and other parts of the Klang Valley.
 Several areas around Kampung Subang were also flooded, affecting roads and residential properties.
 Some reported that the current situation is worse than previous incidents.
 Cars were also reportedly damaged by falling trees. – November 2, 2026
